name: agent-bus
description: Local message bus for agent-to-agent communication across Claude/Codex/Cursor sessions on the same machine. Adds the agent-bus MCP server (20 tools) and the universal coordinator skill. Optional Stop hook for listener resilience (off by default; enable with [features].plugin_hooks = true).

install.note: This plugin requires the @agent-bus-connect/cli npm package to be installed globally. Install with: npm i -g @agent-bus-connect/cli
